usageNotes: Use this to list all remote endpoints (PVE and PBS) configured in Proxmox Datacenter Manager. This is the top-level directory index for the /remotes tree, and is typically called first to discover available remote names before drilling into type-specific paths like /pve/remotes or /pbs/remotes. No parameters are required and any authenticated user can call it.
tips: The response is a directory index, not a typed remote list — use get_pve_remotes or get_pbs_remotes to get structured remote details with connection status.
Accessible to all authenticated users including API tokens; no special privilege is needed.
